scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:studio && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @openevolant/shared && npm run build -w @openevolant/genes && npm run build -w @openevolant/evolution && npm run build -w @openevolant/evaluator && npm run build -w @openevolant/gateway && npm run build -w @openevolant/llm && npm run build -w @openevolant/agent-runner && npm run build -w @openevolant/agentic-loop
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('studio/dist')){console.log('OpenEvolant: 正在构建前端与 CLI...');require('child_process').execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});}"
